scientific_queries.note: Tests whether tissue, known before any measurement, predicts prior strength well enough to apply the rule.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round walks the last remaining application route and closes it with a clear diagnosis.

what_the_data_shows.tissue_level_pattern_matches_C85_in_two_: Colon at 1.67% gains +4.56 pp and Breast at 17.06% loses 6.08 pp, both significant and both as the rule predicts; Pancreas at 12.93% gains +4.83 pp, which the rule does not predict
what_the_data_shows.decisive_problem: Breast's within-tissue standard deviation of prior strength (0.171) equals its mean (0.171), so some Breast cells sit near 2% and others near 30%
what_the_data_shows.honest_verdict: tissue is not uninformative, but the regime a cell is in is largely idiosyncratic, so tissue does not tell you whether to personalise

closure.both_application_routes_are_now_closed: online probing fails on noise (C87) and ex ante assignment fails on within-group spread (this round)
closure.consequence: the conditional rule stands as an explanation but cannot be used as an operating rule on this resource
closure.only_remaining_direction: find features that predict a cell's individual prior strength; this machine has neither expression data nor more than three tissues

limits: only three tissues make the between-group estimate very coarse
the ICC of 0.228 is not far from the 0.30 threshold I pre-registered, so a lower threshold would have flipped the verdict
prior strength and tissue may both be confounded with other cell properties
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI

register_updates.C88: new: the regime is largely idiosyncratic, so ex ante application fails
